introduction: Aloha United Way’s 211 service connects Hawaiʻi residents with local resources. Specialists are available from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m. daily; the online directory can be searched at any time.

sections.who: You can ask for a referral without first qualifying for a public benefit. The organization you are referred to determines its own eligibility, service area and intake requirements.
sections.get: 211 provides information and referrals, with phone, text and live-chat contact options. It does not issue an approval for rent, food or utility payments.
sections.docs:
• Know your island, town or ZIP code.
  • Describe the immediate need and any deadline.
  • Keep a record of the suggested agencies and contact information.
sections.apply:
1. Choose a contact method

    Dial 211 in Hawaiʻi, or use Aloha United Way’s current contact page for phone, text and chat options.

  2. Describe the situation

    Explain which assistance is needed and whether you have already tried a provider.

  3. Follow the referral

    Confirm the receiving agency’s location, eligibility and application arrangements before traveling.
sections.after: If the first option cannot help, ask for another referral. For online searching outside specialist hours, use the directory linked from Aloha United Way.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Aloha United Way 211 contact information. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: The published specialist hours are 7 a.m. to 10 p.m., seven days a week. Online directory searches remain available around the clock.
